data.expected_signal: max_abs_err compared to 1e-6 over all legal FP16 inputs

evidence.summary: Exhaustive sweep of all 47,104 finite FP16 values > -1 (every representable legal input) through kernel.run compared against FP64 torch.log1p: max abs error 1.3007e-6 exceeds the 1e-6 absolute tolerance, with 55 violating inputs; worst case at x=3378.0 (kernel 8.1253338 vs ref 8.1253351).

rationale: The kernel uses a truncated atanh series with truncated coefficients (0.33333, 0.2, 0.142857) and FP32 arithmetic; accumulated error over the full domain could exceed the fixed 1e-6 absolute tolerance.

scope_evidence.summary: Every finite FP16 value strictly greater than -1 is legal ... Every output element must satisfy abs(actual[i] - log(1 + x[i])) <= 1e-6.

scope_rationale: The contract requires abs error <= 1e-6 for every legal FP16 input value > -1; an input-sweep max-abs-error metric directly decides this.
statement: The kernel's output exceeds the 1e-6 absolute tolerance for some finite FP16 value strictly greater than -1.
